items.name: Factorial
items.description: Outputs x!, the product of all integers from 1 to x.

items.name: Grid Pattern
items.description: Outputs a grid of 2D points or boxes, arranged in rows by columns.

items.name: Circle Pattern
items.description: Outputs a set of 2D points evenly spaced along a circular arc. Angle sets how much of the full circle the arc spans. Start Angle rotates the first point.

items.name: Box 2D
items.description: Outputs a box defined by two corner points. Used wherever a node needs a 2D region, like a camera viewport or UV rectangle.

items.name: Intersect
items.description: Tests whether two boxes overlap. Useful for collision detection and region tests.

items.name: Smooth Step
items.description: Outputs a smooth Hermite interpolation between 0 and 1 as the input crosses between two edge values.

items.name: Step
items.description: Outputs 0 when the value is below the edge, 1 otherwise.

items.name: Grid
items.description: Outputs a grid of horizontal and vertical lines.

items.name: Meta Shape
items.description: Maps the input onto a grid of geometric shapes, with each cell's size and form driven by the brightness of the source.

items.name: MIDI Voices
items.description: Routes each incoming note to a separate output channel (a voice), allowing multiple notes to be handled in parallel. When all voices are in use, the longest-silent one is reused.

items.name: Circulate
items.description: Distributes incoming events across output instances one at a time, cycling through each instance in turn.

items.name: Metaballs
items.description: Outputs a grid of metaballs: soft blob shapes that merge smoothly when they get close together. Each cell contains one animated ball.

items.name: Twisted
items.description: Distorts a texture with a wavy twisting motion, shifting pixels in swirling patterns.

items.name: Swap
items.description: Swaps two items in a collection.

items.name: Hexagram
items.description: Outputs a filled hexagram, a six-pointed star made from two overlapping triangles, centered at the origin.

items.name: Sample Texture
items.description: Samples a color from a texture at a given position, optionally averaging over a pixel radius.

items.name: Spiral
items.description: Outputs an animated spiral pattern with configurable arms, windings, and distortion.

items.name: Int
items.description: Converts a value to an integer.

items.name: Suckr
items.description: Pinches or bulges the texture radially around its center, like being sucked into a vortex or pushed outward.

items.name: Reverse
items.description: Reverses a collection.

items.name: Fract
items.description: Outputs the fractional part of the input.

items.name: Asin
items.description: Outputs the arc sine (inverse sine) of the input.

items.name: Spectrum In
items.description: Receives a magnitude spectrum

items.name: Collapse Triggers
items.description: Merges multiple triggers on the same frame into a single trigger.

items.name: Divide
items.description: Outputs the first input divided by each additional input.

items.name: Mirror
items.description: Reflects a shape across a horizontal or vertical axis.

items.name: Color from RGB
items.description: Creates a color from red, green, blue, and alpha channel values.

items.name: Move
items.description: Shifts the input by a given offset.

items.name: Parallelogram
items.description: Outputs a filled parallelogram, a rectangle slanted sideways, centered at the origin.

items.name: Program Change
items.description: Outputs the program number and channel from a MIDI Program Change message.

items.name: Is Inf
items.description: Outputs true when the input is infinite.

items.name: Hue Rotate
items.description: Shifts the hue of all colors around the color wheel by a chosen amount.

items.name: Slice to Shape
items.description: Outputs a slice as a shape. Auto draws the mask polygon if the slice has one, else the main polygon; Ignore Mask always draws the main polygon.

items.name: Negate
items.description: Outputs the input with its sign flipped.

items.name: Checkerboard
items.description: Outputs a checkerboard texture with Rows by Columns cells in two alternating colors.

items.name: System Time
items.description: Outputs the current local time as hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.

items.name: Texture from Data
items.description: Converts a list of values into a texture, where each value becomes one pixel.

items.name: CC Controller
items.description: Outputs the controller number from a MIDI CC message.

items.name: Local Max
items.description: Outputs the maximum value in a collection and its index.

items.name: Less
items.description: Outputs true when the left value is less than the right.

items.name: From Spherical
items.description: Takes 3D spherical coordinates Magnitude (distance to center), Angle X (around the center on the XZ plane) and Angle Y (around the center on the YZ plane) and converts them to 3D cartesian coordinates X, Y and Z.

items.name: Is Note
items.description: Tests whether a MIDI message is a Note On or Note Off.

items.name: Float4
items.description: Builds a 4D vector from component values.

items.name: PolarKaleido
items.description: Combines polar distortion and kaleidoscope reflection, wrapping and mirroring a texture around a center point.

items.name: UV Map
items.description: Remaps a texture's pixels using a UV map, where each pixel's red value gives the horizontal position and green gives the vertical position to sample from the Beauty texture.

items.name: Sqrt
items.description: Outputs the square root of the input.

items.name: Raster
items.description: Keeps every Nth pixel of a texture and blacks out the rest, creating a sparse dotted or scanline look.

items.name: Subtract
items.description: Outputs the first input minus each additional input.

items.name: Trim
items.description: Crops a texture to a rectangular pixel region defined by left, right, top, and bottom edges.

items.name: Fill Fit Stretch
items.description: Fits one dimension into another using Fill, Fit, or Stretch. The Mode attribute controls whether the output is a scale factor or the resulting dimension.

items.name: Element
items.description: Outputs a single component of a vector, color, or other composite value.

items.name: Pass N
items.description: Passes a limited number of events through, then blocks until reset.

items.name: Int In
items.description: Takes an int event into the patch

items.name: Accumulate
items.description: Outputs the running integral of the input over time.

items.name: Polar
items.description: Wraps a texture around a central point, turning horizontal lines into circles.

items.name: Converge
items.description: Takes several parallel event streams and combines them into one, so events from all channels flow through a single connection.

items.name: Align
items.description: Positions a texture within the composition at one of nine alignment points: corners, edges, or center.

items.name: Log
items.description: Outputs the logarithm of the first input with the second input as the base.

items.name: Filter CC
items.description: Outputs the value from a MIDI CC message, only when its controller and channel match.

items.name: Repeat
items.description: Tiles a texture horizontally and vertically into a grid of repeating copies, with optional flipping.

items.name: Frequency to Bpm
items.description: Converts a frequency in Hertz to beats-per-minute.

items.name: Is CC
items.description: Tests whether a MIDI message is a Control Change.

items.name: 1 - x
items.description: Outputs one minus the input. For a probability, gives the complementary probability.

items.name: Ring Buffer
items.description: Keeps a fixed number of recent values in a rotating set of slots, overwriting the oldest whenever a new value arrives.

items.name: Running Total
items.description: Outputs the running total (cumulative sum) of the input values.

items.name: Power
items.description: Outputs the first input raised to the power of the second.

items.name: Find
items.description: Outputs the position of a substring in a string.

items.name: Transformation 2D
items.description: Outputs a 2D transformation that combines position, rotation, and scale. Feed it to any node that places or moves objects in 2D.

items.name: Image
items.description: Loads an image file and outputs it as a texture.

items.name: Join
items.description: Joins multiple inputs into a single collection.

items.name: Expand
items.description: Resizes a collection to a new size by looping, reflecting, or clamping the input values.

items.name: Split
items.description: Splits a collection into its individual elements, one per output.

items.name: Sin
items.description: Outputs the sine of the input.

items.name: Phi
items.description: Outputs the golden ratio.

items.name: Merge
items.description: Combines multiple inputs into one: blends textures, unions shapes, concatenates strings, or merges boxes.

items.name: Slice Info
items.description: Outputs a slice's name, pixel dimensions, center, rotation, shape, and mask.

items.name: Greater
items.description: Outputs true when the left value is greater than the right.

items.name: Comment
items.description: A graphical label to show comments in your patch

items.name: Flip
items.description: Mirrors a texture horizontally, vertically, or both.

items.name: Pixel Gradient
items.description: Outputs how much the brightness changes between neighboring pixels, highlighting areas of rapid change.

items.name: Round
items.description: Outputs the nearest integer to the input.

items.name: Rhombus
items.description: Outputs a filled rhombus, a four-sided diamond shape where all sides have the same length, centered at the origin.

items.name: Is Pitch Bend
items.description: Tests whether a MIDI message is a Pitch Bend.

items.name: Dot Product
items.description: Outputs the dot product of two vectors.

items.name: Local Min
items.description: Outputs the minimum value in a collection and its index.

items.name: Color Mask
items.description: Turns individual red, green, blue, or alpha channels on or off, zeroing out the disabled ones.

items.name: Sqrt2
items.description: Outputs the square root of two.

items.name: Not Equal
items.description: Outputs true when two values are not equal.

items.name: Exclude
items.description: Outputs the non-overlapping parts of two shapes, keeping everything except where they overlap.

items.name: ISF
items.description: Loads an ISF fragment shader and runs it, outputting the result as a texture.

items.name: Triangle
items.description: Outputs a filled triangle defined by three points.

items.name: Read OSC
items.description: Splits an incoming OSC message into a trigger and one output per argument, each matching its data type. Addresses can match specific paths or wildcard patterns.

items.name: Intersection
items.description: Outputs only the region where two shapes overlap, with optional smoothing at the boundary.

items.name: Demultiply Alpha
items.description: Extracts the original color from pixels where transparency has been pre-mixed in, making partially transparent pixels bright again.

items.name: Angle Converter
items.description: Converts an angle between Degree, Radian, and Period units.

items.name: If
items.description: Sends a trigger on the True or False output depending on the condition.

items.name: Sequence
items.description: Outputs a collection of values starting at Begin and incrementing by Step.

items.name: Delay
items.description: Delays the incoming signal or event stream.

items.name: Dimension
items.description: Outputs the width and height of an object.

items.name: Distance Lines
items.description: Outputs concentric outline copies of a shape at regular intervals, like contour lines on a map.

items.name: Color In
items.description: Takes a float4 into the patch as color

items.name: LoRez
items.description: Reduces a texture to a lower resolution, giving it a blocky pixelated look.

items.name: Rectangle
items.description: Outputs a filled rectangle centered at the origin, with optional per-corner rounding.

items.name: Read Note Off
items.description: Outputs the pitch, velocity, and channel from a MIDI Note Off message.

items.name: Toggle
items.description: Outputs a boolean that flips between true and false on each trigger.

items.name: Kuwahara
items.description: Smooths a texture while keeping edges sharp, giving it a painterly look.

items.name: Depth Estimation
items.description:
Tip! Feed at native resolution, before scaling or display transforms.
Generates a depth mask from a texture.

items.name: Hold
items.description: Captures the main input value on Arm, and sends it out on Release.

items.name: CC Value
items.description: Outputs the value from a MIDI CC message.

items.name: MIDI In
items.description: Takes MIDI into the patch

items.name: Perlin
items.description: Outputs a smooth pseudo-random value that varies continuously with the input. Nearby inputs produce nearby outputs, and the same input always produces the same output.

items.name: Mirror Quad
items.description: Reflects a texture into four quadrants, creating a symmetric pattern with horizontal and vertical mirroring.

items.name: Complementary Colors
items.description: Outputs a collection of colors with hues spread evenly around the complement of a base color.

items.name: Static
items.description: Outputs per-pixel random static noise in color, grayscale, or two-tone mode.

items.name: Heart
items.description: Outputs a filled heart with fixed aspect, centered above the origin.

items.name: Quantize
items.description: Snaps the input to the nearest multiple of a step value.

items.name: Random
items.description: Generates random values of a selected type.

items.name: Posterize
items.description: Reduces the number of distinct colors in a texture, giving it a flat poster-like look.

items.name: Is Program Change
items.description: Tests whether a MIDI message is a Program Change.

items.name: Tau
items.description: Outputs the ratio of a circle's circumference to its radius.

items.name: Read Note On
items.description: Outputs the pitch, velocity, and channel from a MIDI Note On message.

items.name: Mode
items.description: Outputs the value that appears most often in a collection, known as the mode.

items.name: From Polar
items.description: Takes 2D polar coordinates Magnitude (distance to center) and Angle (around the center) and converts them to 2D cartesian coordinates X and Y.

items.name: MIDI Out
items.description: Sends a MIDI message out of the patch

items.name: Concatenate
items.description: Joins multiple strings into one, with an optional separator between each.

items.name: Substring
items.description: Outputs part of a string, starting at a given character position and continuing for a given length.

items.name: String
items.description: Converts a value to a string.

items.name: Bool
items.description: Converts a value to a boolean.

items.name: Replace
items.description: Replaces matching parts of a string with a new string.

items.name: Analogous Colors
items.description: Outputs a collection of colors with hues spread evenly around a base color.

items.name: OSC Out
items.description: Sends an OSC message out of the patch

items.name: Distance
items.description: Outputs the distance between two vectors.

items.name: Blur
items.description: Softens a texture by averaging each pixel with nearby pixels, creating a fuzzy out-of-focus look. Adjustable amount, direction, and falloff shape.

items.name: Xor
items.description: Outputs true when an odd number of inputs are true.

items.name: Length
items.description: Outputs the number of characters in a string.

items.name: Read Line
items.description: Outputs the line at a given index in a string.

items.name: Read Word
items.description: Outputs the word at a given index in a string.

items.name: Count Lines
items.description: Outputs the number of lines in a string.

items.name: Count Words
items.description: Outputs the number of words in a string.

items.name: Furthest
items.description: Outputs the index of the collection element with the greatest distance from the search value.

items.name: Invert RGB
items.description: Inverts color channels so each color becomes its complement: red becomes cyan, green becomes magenta, blue becomes yellow.

items.name: Square Oscillator
items.description: Generates a square wave that jumps instantly between high and low values, with no smoothing in between.

items.name: Buffer
items.description: Records the most recent values as they arrive, keeping a fixed number of them at all times.

items.name: Date
items.description: Outputs the current local date as year, month, week, day, and weekday.

items.name: OSC In
items.description: Takes OSC into the patch

items.name: Pitch Bend
items.description: Outputs the pitch bend amount from a MIDI Pitch Bend message, a signed value from -1 (full down) to +1 (full up).

items.name: Transport Info
items.description: Outputs the host transport's BPM, beat count, and time signature.

items.name: Transport Beat
items.description: Outputs beat counts at eight bar subdivisions (1/1 through 1/16), driven by the host's transport.

items.name: To Float4
items.description: Converts a value to a 4D vector.

items.name: To Polar
items.description: Converts a 2D position into distance from the center (Magnitude) and angle around the center (Angle).

items.name: Saturation
items.description: Adjusts how vivid or washed-out colors appear, from full greyscale to over-saturated.

items.name: Transport Play
items.description: Fires triggers on host transport play, pause, and stop events, and outputs the current playing state.

items.name: Min
items.description: Outputs the minimum value in a collection.

items.name: Switch
items.description: Takes several cases and selects one of them for output through the selection input. The selection input determines when a case value will be sent out to the output.

items.name: Gate
items.description: Takes several cases and passes through one of them based on the selection. The selection input determines which of the cases will be passed through.

items.name: Pentagon
items.description: Outputs a filled regular pentagon with five equal sides, centered at the origin.

items.name: Trigger
items.description: Emits a trigger when any event is received.

items.name: Max
items.description: Outputs the maximum value in a collection.

items.name: Pitch
items.description: Outputs the pitch from a MIDI Note message.

items.name: LUT 3D Resource
items.description: Outputs a 3D LUT resource, a reference to a 3D lookup table file used by color-grading nodes to remap colors.

items.name: To Float3
items.description: Converts a value to a 3D vector.

items.name: LUT 3D In
items.description: Takes a LUT 3D Resource into the patch

items.name: Pitch to Frequency
items.description: Outputs the frequency in Hz for a MIDI pitch.

items.name: Clamp
items.description: Restricts a value to a range. Values inside the range pass through unchanged; values outside are snapped to the nearest bound.

items.name: Star
items.description: Outputs a filled pointy star with a configurable number of points.

items.name: Pixel Blur
items.description: Softens a texture using a high-quality blur that averages nearby pixels.

items.name: Hexagon
items.description: Outputs a filled regular hexagon with six equal sides, centered at the origin.

items.name: None
items.description: Outputs true when every element in a collection is false.

items.name: All
items.description: Outputs true when all elements in a collection are true.

items.name: Ceil
items.description: Outputs the smallest integer greater than or equal to the input.

items.name: Host Info
items.description: Outputs the host application's name, vendor, and whether it's running in editor mode.

items.name: Octagon
items.description: Outputs a filled regular octagon with eight equal sides, centered at the origin.

items.name: Derivative
items.description: Outputs the rate of change of the input over time.

items.name: Modulo
items.description: Outputs the remainder of the first input divided by the second.

items.name: Cross Fader
items.description: Blends between two inputs based on a mix value, from fully Input 1 at 0 to fully Input 2 at 1.

items.name: Transition
items.description: Fades between two textures, with a choice of how the pixels of the two combine.

items.name: Pi
items.description: Outputs the ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.

items.name: Image Resource
items.description: Outputs an image resource, a reference to an image file. Other nodes can use it to access the image, or it can be stored in a collection.

items.name: Or
items.description: Outputs true when at least one input is true.

items.name: Auto Mask
items.description: Makes the texture transparent based on the brightness of the image or a chosen color channel.

items.name: Color
items.description: Outputs a color, either from a color value or by parsing a hex string.

items.name: 1 / x
items.description: Outputs the reciprocal of the input (one divided by the input).

items.name: Write Note On
items.description: Outputs a MIDI Note On message on each Write trigger, or a Note Off when velocity is 0 and Vel. 0 = Off is on.

items.name: Write Program Change
items.description: Outputs a MIDI Program Change message on each Write trigger.

items.name: Smooth
items.description: Outputs a smoothed version of the input signal, following it with a configurable response time.

items.name: Acos
items.description: Outputs the arc cosine (inverse cosine) of the input.

items.name: Any
items.description: Outputs true when at least one element in a collection is true.

items.name: Average
items.description: Outputs the average of the values in a collection.

items.name: Timeline
items.description: Ramps from Start Value to End Value over Duration seconds. Play, Pause, Stop, Restart, and Rewind control playback.

items.name: Transport Time
items.description: Outputs the host transport's elapsed seconds, bars, and beats.

items.name: Greyscale
items.description: Removes all color from a texture, leaving only shades of grey, using one of several methods.

items.name: Write OSC
items.description: Builds an OSC message from an address and an optional typed value, emitted each time Write triggers.

items.name: Color Offset
items.description: Shifts the red, green, and blue channels by separate amounts, creating a chromatic aberration effect.

items.name: Difference
items.description: Outputs the transformation that maps one box to another.

items.name: Chevron
items.description: Outputs a filled chevron, shaped like an arrow or a V, centered at the origin.

items.name: Image In
items.description: Takes an Image Resource into the patch

items.name: Count
items.description: Counts how many elements in a collection match a value.

items.name: Replace NaN
items.description: Replaces any NaN input value with a fallback value.

items.name: Exposure
items.description: Brightens or darkens a texture like adjusting a camera's exposure, boosting or dimming all pixels while keeping their relative differences.

items.name: Tan
items.description: Outputs the tangent of the input.

items.name: Atan
items.description: Outputs the arc tangent (inverse tangent) of the input.

items.name: Camera 2D
items.description: Defines the viewport for 2D rendering. The viewport is the area of the scene that will be visible. Aspect Ratio mode matches the output's aspect ratio. Absolute mode uses a fixed rectangular area.

items.name: Floor
items.description: Outputs the largest integer less than or equal to the input.

items.name: Texture from Channels
items.description: Packs four single-channel textures into a combined RGBA texture.

items.name: Read CC
items.description: Outputs the controller, channel, and value from a MIDI CC message.

items.name: Transform
items.description: Translates, scales, and rotates a texture, shape, point, box, mesh, or slice.

items.name: Spokes
items.description: Outputs filled radial bars extending from the origin like wheel spokes, with adjustable count and thickness.

items.name: Colorize
items.description: Tints a texture based on its brightness, using either a single color or a color palette.

items.name: Truncate
items.description: Outputs the input with its fractional part dropped (rounded toward zero).

items.name: Triangulate
items.description: Divides a texture into triangular patches of averaged color, giving it a low-poly or mosaic look.

items.name: Kaleidoscope
items.description: Reflects a texture repeatedly around a center point, creating a symmetric kaleidoscope pattern.

items.name: Tint
items.description: Remaps the dark and light areas of a texture to two chosen colors, replacing the original color range.

items.name: Nearest
items.description: Outputs the index of the collection element with the smallest distance from the search value.

items.name: Triangle Oscillator
items.description: Generates a triangle wave that ramps linearly up, then linearly back down, creating a zigzag pattern.

items.name: Polkadot
items.description: Replaces a texture with a repeating pattern of dots whose size depends on the original brightness.

items.name: Absolute
items.description: Outputs the absolute value of the input.

items.name: UV Texture
items.description: Outputs a texture where each pixel's red channel stores its own horizontal position and green stores its vertical position. Useful as a starting point for effects that remap pixels using UV coordinates.

items.name: Map
items.description: Remaps a value from one range to another. For example, 10 in the range (0, 100) mapped to (50, 60) becomes 51.

items.name: Bool In
items.description: Takes a boolean into the patch

items.name: Velocity
items.description: Outputs the velocity from a MIDI Note message.

items.name: Replace Inf
items.description: Replaces any infinite input value with a fallback value.

items.name: Subtract
items.description: Cuts one or more shapes away from a base shape.

items.name: Edge Detection
items.description: Detects and highlights edges in a texture, the places where neighboring pixels have very different colors or brightness.

items.name: Hatched
items.description: Replaces the texture with a cross-hatched line pattern whose density follows the original brightness.

items.name: Crop
items.description: Crops a texture to a rectangular region defined by left, right, top, and bottom edges.

items.name: Multiply
items.description: Outputs the product of the input values.

items.name: Is NaN
items.description: Outputs true when the input is NaN (not a number).

items.name: Video Mixer
items.description: Combines multiple texture layers into one, where each layer's opacity controls how much it mixes in and a blend mode chooses how its pixels combine with the layers under it.

items.name: Perlin Generator
items.description: Generates a smoothly varying random signal. Unlike white noise, consecutive values are correlated, giving gradual natural-feeling variation.

items.name: Euler
items.description: Outputs the base of the natural logarithm.

items.name: Repeat
items.description: Tiles a shape into a grid of repeating copies.

items.name: Exp
items.description: Outputs e raised to the power of the input.

items.name: Linear
items.description: Outputs a collection of evenly spaced values between Min and Max.

items.name: Add Subtract
items.description: Adds or subtracts color values per channel, shifting the red, green, and blue of each pixel.

items.name: To Texture
items.description: Converts a shape or another texture into a Texture2D with a chosen resolution and filtering.

items.name: Video Resource
items.description: Outputs a video resource, a reference to a video file. Other nodes can use it to play or sample the video, or it can be stored in a collection.

items.name: Outside
items.description: Outputs true when the input falls outside the range or bounding area.

items.name: Is Note On
items.description: Tests whether a MIDI message is a Note On.

items.name: Curve
items.description: Applies an easing curve to an input between 0 and 1, shaping the linear progression.

items.name: Size
items.description: Outputs the size of a collection.

items.name: Indices
items.description: Outputs a collection of integer indices, one per element of the input collection.

items.name: Span
items.description: Outputs a portion of a collection, starting at a given position and continuing for a given length.

items.name: Shuffle
items.description: Outputs a collection in a random order.

items.name: Write
items.description: Outputs a collection with a value written at a given position.

items.name: Read
items.description: Outputs the element of a collection at a given position.

items.name: Shift
items.description: Shifts the elements of a collection by an offset.

items.name: Insert
items.description: Inserts one or more elements into a collection at a given position.

items.name: Filter Note On
items.description: Outputs the velocity from a MIDI Note On message, only when its pitch and channel match.

items.name: Sum
items.description: Outputs the sum of the values in a collection.

items.name: Add
items.description: Outputs the sum of the input values.

items.name: Magnitude
items.description: Outputs the magnitude of a value, such as the length of a vector.

items.name: LUT
items.description: Applies a 3D lookup table to remap the colors of a texture, commonly used for color grading.

items.name: Edge
items.description: Turns a filled shape into an outline stroke of a given thickness.

items.name: Moon
items.description: Outputs a filled crescent moon with adjustable radii and separation.

items.name: Pixelate
items.description: Reduces a texture to blocks of solid color, creating a pixelated retro look.

items.name: Polygon
items.description: Outputs a filled polygon defined by a list of points connected in order.

items.name: Line
items.description: Outputs a line segment between two points.

items.name: Not
items.description: Outputs the logical negation of a boolean.

items.name: Hub
items.description: Forwards the incoming value to its output.

items.name: Filter Note Off
items.description: Outputs the velocity from a MIDI Note Off message, only when its pitch and channel match.

items.name: Time
items.description: Splits a time in seconds into hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds components.

items.name: Normalize
items.description: Outputs a vector scaled to length 1, preserving its direction.

items.name: Texture In
items.description: Takes a texture signal into the patch

items.name: Nor
items.description: Outputs true only when all inputs are false.

items.name: To Float2
items.description: Converts a value to a 2D vector.

items.name: Duration
items.description: Outputs the duration of a video or audio resource, in seconds.

items.name: Equilateral Triangle
items.description: Outputs a filled equilateral triangle with three equal sides, centered at the origin.

items.name: Round
items.description: Grows a shape outward by a given amount, rounding its corners in the process.

items.name: Bloom
items.description: Makes bright areas of a texture glow outward, like a camera overexposing highlights.

items.name: Fallback
items.description: Tracks the peak of the input and decays back down to a fallback value over a given duration.

items.name: Equal
items.description: Outputs true when two values are equal.

items.name: Bendoscope
items.description: Distorts a texture in a polar, kaleidoscope-like pattern with adjustable angular repetitions.

items.name: Resize
items.description: Resizes a texture to a target resolution, with options for how to fit it.

items.name: UV Offset
items.description: Distorts a texture by shifting each pixel's sampling position based on a second texture's color values.

items.name: Radar
items.description: Sweeps a rotating line across the texture like a radar scanner, revealing pixels as it passes.

items.name: Sort
items.description: Outputs the input collection sorted in ascending or descending order.

items.name: Cross Product
items.description: Outputs the cross product of two vectors.

items.name: Threshold
items.description: Replaces each pixel with one of two colors based on whether its brightness is above or below a threshold.

items.name: Tile
items.description: Tiles and skews a texture into a repeating pattern.

items.name: Bright.Contrast
items.description: Lightens or darkens a texture, and strengthens or weakens the difference between its light and dark areas.

items.name: Envelope Follower
items.description: Outputs a smoothed signal that tracks the amplitude of the input.

items.name: Sign
items.description: Outputs -1, 0, or 1 depending on the sign of the input.

items.name: Texture Out
items.description: Sends a texture out of the patch

items.name: Displace
items.description: Outputs a shape whose outline falls roughly midway between the outlines of two input shapes, mixing features from both.

items.name: ISF Resource
items.description: Outputs an ISF resource, a reference to an ISF fragment shader file that shader-running nodes can execute.

items.name: Trapezoid
items.description: Outputs a filled trapezoid, a four-sided shape with parallel top and bottom edges of different widths, centered at the origin.

items.name: Cross
items.description: Outputs a filled plus-sign cross with adjustable arm thickness and corner rounding, centered at the origin.

items.name: Write Note Off
items.description: Outputs a MIDI Note Off message on each Write trigger.

items.name: Levels
items.description: Adjusts the dark and light points of a texture, controlling its overall brightness and contrast like a photo levels adjustment.

items.name: Noise Generator
items.description: Outputs independent random values at every sample, like static or the hiss of white noise.

items.name: Replace Alpha
items.description: Replaces the alpha channel of a texture or color with a given value.

items.name: And
items.description: Outputs true only when all inputs are true.

items.name: Mask
items.description: Uses one texture as a mask to control the visibility of another texture, multiplying them together.

items.name: Float3
items.description: Builds a 3D vector from component values.

items.name: Pie
items.description: Outputs a filled pie-slice wedge with adjustable radius and opening angle, centered at the origin.

items.name: Counter
items.description: Outputs a counter that starts at Start and advances by Step on each Trigger. Reset returns it to Start.

items.name: Vibrance
items.description: Increases the intensity of muted, less-saturated colors while leaving already-vivid colors mostly unchanged.

items.name: Vignette
items.description: Darkens or colors the corners of a texture, fading inward toward the center like a photo vignette.

items.name: Mask Blend
items.description: Mixes two textures together, with a third mask texture deciding where each one shows through.

items.name: Float In
items.description: Takes a float event into the patch

items.name: Fader
items.description: Fades a texture in or out by scaling all its channels by a gain value.

items.name: Union
items.description: Combines multiple shapes into one merged surface, with a choice of smooth, stepped, or beveled seams where they meet.

items.name: Snapshot
items.description: Emits the current signal value as an event when triggered.

items.name: Ripple
items.description: Distorts a texture with circular waves emanating from a center point, like ripples on water.

items.name: Bpm to Frequency
items.description: Converts beats-per-minute to frequency in Hertz.

items.name: Video In
items.description: Takes a Video Resource into the patch

items.name: Texture Material
items.description: Creates a 2D material that bundles a texture, tint color, and rendering settings, defining how a 2D mesh will look when drawn.

items.name: Attack Release
items.description: Outputs a value that rises from 0 to 1 over Attack Time when triggered, then falls back to 0 over Release Time, like a fade-in fade-out shape.

items.name: Vesica
items.description: Outputs a filled vesica, a lens or eye shape formed by the overlap of two circles, centered at the origin.

items.name: Unpack
items.description: Outputs each component of a vector, color, or texture on a separate output.

items.name: To Cylindrical
items.description: Converts a 3D position into distance from the center (Magnitude), angle around the center on the XY plane (Angle) and height along the Y axis (Height).

items.name: Bag
items.description: Outputs a random integer each Trigger. Each value in the bag appears exactly once before the bag reshuffles and starts over.

items.name: To Spherical
items.description: Converts a 3D position into distance from the center (Magnitude), angle around the center on the XZ plane (Angle X) and angle around the center on the YZ plane (Angle Y).

items.name: Within
items.description: Outputs true when the input falls within the range or bounding area.

items.name: ChromaKey
items.description: Makes pixels matching a chosen color transparent, commonly used to remove a green or blue screen background.

items.name: Channel
items.description: Outputs the channel number from a MIDI message.

items.name: Write CC
items.description: Outputs a MIDI CC message on each Write trigger.

items.name: Nand
items.description: Outputs true except when all inputs are true.

items.name: Mirror
items.description: Reflects one half of a texture over the other, making the output symmetric along a chosen axis.

items.name: Text Render
items.description: Renders text to a texture. With Instanced Output on, each text instance becomes its own output texture.

items.name: Stack
items.description: Stores values that you push onto it. Pop removes the most recent one, like a stack of plates where you can only take from the top.

items.name: Rotation
items.description: Outputs the rotation of a slice, in turns.

items.name: Center
items.description: Outputs the center of a slice or box.

items.name: Slice Mask
items.description: Outputs a slice's mask as a shape.

items.name: Slice
items.description: Converts the input into a Slice. A slice is a rectangular region of the composition with its own position, rotation, and mask, typically used for mapping the output onto physical surfaces.

items.name: Fractal Noise
items.description: Outputs a cloud-like noise texture made by layering smooth random noise at multiple scales on top of each other, giving natural-looking detail.

items.name: Circle
items.description: Outputs a circle as 2D geometry. Combine with a 2D transform and a material to make it renderable.

items.name: Slice In
items.description: Takes a slice signal into the patch

items.name: Trigger In
items.description: Takes a trigger event into the patch

items.name: On Change
items.description: Emits an event when the input signal value changes.

items.name: Find Replace
items.description: Replaces all matching values in a collection with a new value.

items.name: Is Note Off
items.description: Tests whether a MIDI message is a Note Off.

items.name: Drop Shadow
items.description: Draws a colored copy of the texture offset behind it as a shadow.

items.name: Float2
items.description: Builds a 2D vector from component values.

items.name: Slide
items.description: Scrolls the texture horizontally and vertically, wrapping around at the edges.

items.name: Dilate
items.description: Expands the bright or dark regions of a texture, growing them outward.

items.name: Mesh 2D
items.description: Combines 2D geometry with a transform that positions it and a material that gives it color and texture, producing a complete 2D mesh ready to render.

items.name: Solid Color
items.description: Outputs a texture filled with a single color.

items.name: Slice Render
items.description: Renders one or more slices to a texture. With Instanced Output on, each slice becomes its own texture.

items.name: 2D Render
items.description: Renders 2D meshes into a texture using a camera viewport. By default all meshes combine into one texture. Enable Instanced Output to produce one texture per mesh instance.

items.name: Rectangle
items.description: Outputs a rectangle as 2D geometry. Combine with a 2D transform and a material to make it renderable.

items.name: Equilateral Triangle
items.description: Outputs an equilateral triangle as 2D geometry. Combine with a 2D transform and a material to make it renderable.

items.name: Float
items.description: Converts a value to a float.

items.name: Circle
items.description: Outputs a filled circle centered at the origin.

items.name: Shape Render
items.description: Renders one or more shapes to a texture with a given fill color.

items.name: Change Case
items.description: Outputs a string in lowercase or uppercase.

items.name: Patch Info
items.description: Outputs the host's current patch name, video resolution, aspect ratio, and bit depth.

items.name: Sine Oscillator
items.description: Generates a smoothly oscillating sine wave, like a pendulum or ocean waves rising and falling.

items.name: Transpose
items.description: Outputs the transpose of the input matrix.

items.name: Color from HSB
items.description: Creates a color from hue, saturation, brightness, and alpha values.

items.name: Sharpen
items.description: Enhances edges in a texture to make details appear crisper and more defined.

items.name: Dot Screen
items.description: Renders a texture as a halftone pattern of dots, like old newspaper printing.

items.name: Median
items.description: Outputs the middle value of a collection when sorted, known as the median.

items.name: Rings
items.description: Outputs concentric rings or arcs. Color interpolates from Color 1 at the inner ring to Color 2 at the outer ring. Style picks filled, stroked, or alternating.

items.name: Premultiply Alpha
items.description: Pre-mixes transparency into each pixel's color: partially transparent pixels become darker. Many renderers require this for correct blending.

items.name: Cos
items.description: Outputs the cosine of the input.

items.name: Color Pass
items.description: Keeps pixels whose hue falls within a chosen range in color, and desaturates everything else to grey.

items.name: Fish Eye
items.description: Distorts a texture into a spherical bulge, like looking through a fisheye camera lens.

items.name: Human Segmentation
items.description:
Tip! Feed at native resolution, before scaling or display transforms.
Generates a mask of human subjects in a texture.

items.name: Dither
items.description: Converts a texture to a dotted pattern where each pixel is either its original color or black, based on brightness.

items.name: String In
items.description: Takes text into the patch

items.name: Anchor Point
items.description: Outputs a corner, edge midpoint, or center of a 2D object's bounding box.

items.name: Displace
items.description: Shifts each pixel by an amount based on its brightness, creating a distortion effect.

items.name: Write Pitch Bend
items.description: Outputs a MIDI Pitch Bend message on each Write trigger.

items.name: From Cylindrical
items.description: Takes 3D cylindrical coordinates Magnitude (distance to center), Angle (around the center on the XY plane) and Height (along the Y axis) and converts them to 3D cartesian coordinates X, Y and Z.

items.name: Bounding Box
items.description: Outputs the smallest box that fully contains an object. Useful for measuring size, position, or overlap.

items.name: Transport Tick
items.description: Fires a tick on each beat scaled by Multiplier, and outputs the number of ticks per bar.

items.name: Saw Oscillator
items.description: Generates a sawtooth wave that ramps up smoothly from low to high, then instantly drops back to low, like a saw blade's teeth.

items.name: Video Sampler
items.description: Outputs a single frame of a video at a chosen position, from 0 (start) to 1 (end).

items.name: Twirl
items.description: Twists a texture around a center point, creating a spiral swirl effect.

items.name: Print
items.description: Prints each incoming value to Wire's log.

items.name: Atan2
items.description: Computes the arc tangent of y/x using the signs of the given input to determine the correct quadrant.

items.name: Gradient
items.description: Outputs a gradient texture. Method picks two-color or palette. Type picks horizontal, vertical, radial, or angular. Mode toggles smooth or stepped.

items.name: Wrap
items.description: Wraps a number into a range, cycling back to the start when it exceeds either bound.

items.name: Metronome
items.description: Fires a trigger at a steady rate set by Frequency. Also outputs a ramping phase and a running count.

items.name: Video Player
items.description: Plays a video file, with controls for play, pause, stop, speed, and looping.

items.name: Gaussian
items.description: Outputs the bell-curve function value for an input, optionally normalized.
